roster.name: LINCS iPSC Metadata Specification (2017)
roster.description: A detailed metadata schema for induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) records within the LINCS program: field names, cardinality/importance (required/optional), and controlled-vocabulary guidance for iPSC identifiers, provenance (center, batch, provider), cell-line properties (known mutations, genetic modifications, molecular features), production/derivation details, culture/passaging conditions, quality verification and related citations.

roster.name: LINCS Common Metadata Fields (2017)
roster.description: The LINCS common metadata framework referenced by the iPSC specification: a set of fields and classifications shared across LINCS metadata standards (canonical vs batch vs custom fields), intended to provide consistent identifiers and provenance (e.g. canonical IDs, center/batch IDs, provider info) and to be reused by multiple LINCS entity-specific standards.
